tools.name: read_x_article
tools.description: Returns an X (Twitter) Article as Markdown with images in place. X only shows Articles to signed-in readers, so fetching the link directly gets a login page. Pass the link of the post the Article was published in. Optionally translate it with lang.

tools.name: get_x_video_transcript
tools.description: Returns the transcript of the video in an X (Twitter) post: X's own captions when they exist, or a transcript x-toolkit made earlier. If there is none yet, it says so; call transcribe_x_video to make one.

tools.name: transcribe_x_video
tools.description: Transcribes the video in an X post that has no captions, one part (about 108 seconds of audio) per call. Start with part 0. Each call says whether to call again with the next part; the last one returns the transcript. The transcript is saved, so get_x_video_transcript works for it afterwards. Videos

tools.name: read_x_post
tools.description: Returns a single X (Twitter) post as Markdown: author, date, text, the quoted post, image links and counts. For an Article use read_x_article; for a video's words use get_x_video_transcript.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_x_article, get_x_video_transcript, read_x_post · Public sink: read_x_article, get_x_video_transcript, transcribe_x_video, read_x_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_x_article, get_x_video_transcript, read_x_post · Public sink: read_x_article, get_x_video_transcript, transcribe_x_video, read_x_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
